name: Christian McCaffrey
rationale: [INJURY REVIEW 2026-08-27: moved #1 -> #4 (behind Bijan/Gibbs/Taylor) — persistent, unresolved calf/soft-tissue "tightness" since 2026-08-10, still not fully practicing as of 2026-08-20; echoes the downplayed-calf-that-became-a-lost-half-season pattern from 2024 (out until Wk10). Raw VORP reflects peak-healthy production, not this recurring durability risk.]

name: Ashton Jeanty
rationale: [INJURY REVIEW 2026-08-27: moved #17 -> #26 — fresh right ankle sprain suffered 2026-08-25 (2 days before draft); ESPN reports it's believed low- rather than high-ankle and not major, but explicitly flags a real chance he sits Week 1 and that a high-ankle read could linger into the season. Re-check status night-of if any further update lands.]

name: Jeremiyah Love
rationale: Consensus #1 rookie overall; clear immediate RB1 role in ARI (light committee risk from Allgeier/Conner) — placed near the RB24 landmark (2025 data: rank 44 ≈ 46.5 vorp), reflecting round-1 RB's 71.4% top-24 historical hit rate plus a genuinely uncontested-enough opportunity profile.

name: Jadarian Price
rationale: R1 pick (Seattle, last pick of round 1) into a wide-open backfield — Kenneth Walker III departed, Zach Charbonnet recovering from ACL — the single best pure opportunity-share situation in this rookie class per wiki/team/rookie-evaluation.md's RB secondary signal; placed just behind Love, still inside the RB24 band.

name: Carnell Tate
rationale: R1 (pick 4 overall, elite draft capital), frontrunner for WR1 volume in TEN despite 'mild risk' (new coaching staff, year-2 QB) — placed just above the WR24 landmark (rank 70 ≈ 22.5 vorp), consensus #2 rookie overall.

name: Makai Lemon
rationale: R1 to PHI (pick 20) — inherits a share of A.J. Brown's vacated 121 targets but not a clean 1-for-1 replacement given the crowded WR room; consensus #4 rookie overall, placed in the WR24-36 band reflecting shared-target risk.

name: Kenyon Sadiq
rationale: R1 TE (pick 16, NYJ) — round-1 TE carries the strongest positional hit rate in the whole rookie-evaluation framework (81.8% top-24, 54.5% top-12) and he's specifically flagged for immediate impact; placed just below the TE12 landmark (rank 80 ≈ 13.1 vorp, Brock Bowers), reflecting strong-likely-TE1-of-class upside without assuming the guaranteed outcome.

name: De'Zhaun Stribling
rationale: R2 pick, but consensus fantasy ranking (#5 overall rookie) ranks him ABOVE several round-1 WRs (Tyson, Concepcion, Boston, Cooper) on situational/landing-spot grounds — exactly the 'weight landing spot over pure draft capital' override wiki/team/rookie-evaluation.md's best-ball framing calls for. Placed ahead of the round-1 WRs it out-ranks in consensus.

name: Zach Charbonnet
rationale: [INJURY REVIEW 2026-08-27: moved #48 -> #100 — remains on PUP as of late Aug camp reports recovering from a Jan-2026-playoffs torn ACL; still on PUP at the 53-man cutdown forces a minimum 4-game absence, real risk of missing a meaningful chunk of the season behind Kenneth Walker III.]

name: KC Concepcion
rationale: R1 to CLE (consensus #7 rookie overall) — placed in the WR24-36 band behind the higher-consensus R1 WRs, ahead of teammate Boston per consensus ordering.

name: Denzel Boston
rationale: R1 to CLE alongside Concepcion (consensus #8 rookie overall) — two round-1 rookie WRs sharing one offense tempers each other's target share relative to a clean WR1 situation; placed just behind Concepcion per consensus.

name: Omar Cooper
rationale: R1 to NYJ (consensus #10 rookie overall) — 'ceiling may not be as high as others... physical and accountable' framing (modest 53/623/4 projection) argues for a real-but-unspectacular floor play; placed at the lower end of the round-1 WR cluster, still ahead of the WR48 landmark.

name: Kaelon Black
rationale: R3 RB (SF) — RB is this evaluation framework's most forgiving position (day-2/3 capital 'comparable to R1 at the top-36 tier' per wiki/team/rookie-evaluation.md), and he's a surprisingly strong consensus #17 rookie overall for a day-3 pick; placed near the RB36-48 band rather than left at replacement level.

name: Germie Bernard
rationale: R2 WR (SF, Stribling's teammate) but absent from the consensus rookie top-20 unlike Stribling/Boston — no standout situational report found; placed as a marginal WR depth flier just behind Black, not meaningfully elevated above his round-2 baseline.

name: Fernando Mendoza
rationale: R1 QB (LV) — consensus top rookie QB (#12 overall, 'no quarterback cracks the top 10') and round-1 QB carries the single strongest positional hit-rate signal in the whole framework (84% of fantasy-relevant rookie QBs are R1), but this league's single-QB/no-superflex format explicitly deprioritizes QB investment per wiki/team/rookie-evaluation.md — placed as a late speculative stash, not chased up the board.

name: Jordyn Tyson
rationale: R1 (pick 8, NO) — elite pre-injury college profile and the single best per-game production projection among rookie WRs (CBS: 61/869/4), but a late-2025 hamstring injury tempers consensus rank (#6) below Tate/Lemon/Stribling; placed accordingly, still solidly inside the WR24-36 band. [INJURY REVIEW 2026-08-27: moved #96 -> #177 — hamstring injury from an 2026-08 joint practice expected to cost roughly two months, likely opening the season on IR; too large a games-missed hit for a rookie WR's speculative upside to justify the original rookie-round insertion slot.]

name: Ty Simpson
rationale: R1 QB, but absent from the consensus rookie top-20 (Mendoza is the only QB to crack it) — no standout situational signal found and this league deprioritizes rookie QB value regardless; placed as the lowest-priority QB in this flagged batch.

name: Jayden Higgins
rationale: [INJURY REVIEW 2026-08-27: moved #149 -> #298 — placed on season-ending IR 2026-08-21 (torn ACL); out for all of 2026, no realistic draft-day value this season.]

name: Ricky Pearsall
